start_conditions: Commences strictly on the retail purchase date verified by official invoice.
repair_conditions: Repairs must be conducted solely at authorized service hubs utilizing genuine OEM components.
replacement_conditions: Full unit replacement is authorized only if primary motherboard failure recurs more than twice within first 90 days.
hard_fail_rules: Claim submitted after warranty expiry and grace period has elapsed
Evidence of liquid ingress or immersion detected
Physical impact shattering or structural casing rupture
Disassembly, repair, or tampering performed by an unauthorized service center
Serial number on unit defaced, missing, or mismatched against invoice
warning_rules: Claim reported more than 21 days after fault manifestation date
Claim filed during post-expiry grace period window (within 7 days)
More than one previous component repair logged in past 6 months
manual_review_rules: Dual-model prediction disagreement between Python and Teachable Machine
Model confidence score falls below configurable minimum threshold
OCR extracted invoice serial differs by minor character variance from registration
Affidavit submitted in lieu of official tax invoice
Duplicate claim or invoice number detected in registry
